items.title: Conditions for a Proposition to be Satisfiable (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Conditions for a Proposition to be Satisfiable (PDF 30, printed 26).

blocks.text: Proposition satisfiable hai agar truth values ka kam az kam ek combination usay sach bana de. Agar tamam mumkin combinations usay jhoot banayein to woh unsatisfiable hai. Satisfiability expression ki banawat (structure) aur us mein lage connectives par depend karti hai. AND, OR aur NOT jaise connectives tay karte hain ke statement sach ho sakta hai ya nahi. Truth table bana kar har soorat check karna satisfiability test karne ka ek tareeqa hai. Jis proposition ka kam az kam ek nateeja “true” ho, woh satisfiable hai. Yeh shart reasoning aur faisla karne mein kaam aati hai.

items: Satisfiable: kam az kam ek combination par sach.
Truth table ki saari rows dekh kar check karo.
